question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

ZZZ CCC FFF III ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is a consistent increase of 3 in the alphabetical position for each of the three letters, with the series wrapping around from Z to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2eb78e6243b01add96ee87aaa499860035266a82001fd1635c5a4a2ba0abb3c.png] 

Thus, the missing letter-cluster in the series is **LLL**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
